purpose: Local presentation assets for airline identity. Technical travel inventory remains mocked; assets establish no commercial relationship, integration, current operating status or route availability.
licenseScope: Per-file source metadata and claims, not a blanket open license or trademark permission. Wikipedia fair-use references are explicitly non-free; the repository does not grant reuse permission.
identityPolicy: Three owner-approved fixture presentation aliases use a matching name and mark together. Exact airline: identifiers are available for the collected library. Unmapped or transport-mismatched identities retain the neutral fallback.
